implementation_matrix.mechanism: Actionable state excludes any batch with deadline_step <= t; due-now mass is audit-only and expires before service.
implementation_matrix.runtime_evidence: Full a-d gate is 20/20 safe with total expiry 0 in both regions.

implementation_matrix.mechanism: Cumulative exact EDF uses frozen causal envelopes to force enough work now that every known deadline and episode end remain schedulable.
implementation_matrix.runtime_evidence: Preflight observed maxima service 2.130388 and batch 0.831723 below envelopes 2.25/1.0; training records mandatory EDF steps and full a-d/e-h expiry remains zero.

implementation_matrix.mechanism: Service guarantee is clean-state only: any preexisting local service backlog fails closed instead of being silently pooled.
implementation_matrix.runtime_evidence: Full a-d maximum terminal service backlog is exactly 0.0 in both regions.

implementation_matrix.mechanism: Origin-destination batch flow is exact and conservation is checked at step level and episode summary level.
implementation_matrix.runtime_evidence: Full a-d max transport conservation error is 2.498e-16 (US) and 3.053e-16 (Global).

implementation_matrix.mechanism: Exact drain endpoints are preserved: the projector can realize true 0% and 100% drains when required.
implementation_matrix.runtime_evidence: Adversarial tests exercise both exact endpoints; every stage-region training group records nonzero exact-full-drain counts. The measured traces did not require exact-zero overrides.

implementation_matrix.mechanism: Hard infeasibility certificates fail closed on envelope overruns, missed deadlines, and mandatory-capacity deficits.
implementation_matrix.runtime_evidence: Replay, short, medium, full, and e-h all report zero safety infeasibility certificates; all 36 training.json files also report zero.

implementation_matrix.mechanism: The shield applies a minimal Euclidean projection and records intervention/projection telemetry rather than replacing the policy with a rule-based controller.
implementation_matrix.runtime_evidence: Global replay intervention is +0.473%, while the trained full a-d policy is still changed on +18.786% of steps.

implementation_matrix.mechanism: PPO is trained with the projector active and every intervention, projection distance, binding horizon, deadline slack, exact endpoint, flush, certificate, and conservation metric is persisted.
implementation_matrix.runtime_evidence: All 36 hash-verified training diagnostics contain projector telemetry and zero infeasibility certificates.

implementation_matrix.mechanism: Negative-demand flush exists as an optional ablation, not the primary protocol.
implementation_matrix.runtime_evidence: Replay flush ablation remains 10/10 safe in both regions but raises mean intervention to 23.90% (US) and 48.52% (Global); it is reported as economic ablation only.

implementation_matrix.mechanism: Grid and ramp caps are implemented in the shield, but the primary frozen protocol leaves both disabled.
implementation_matrix.runtime_evidence: All 36 completion records show primary max_grid_mw=null and max_upward_ramp_mw=null, matching the protocol snapshot.

actionable_state.deadline_semantics: An entry with deadline_step d is serviceable through d-1 and expires before service at d. The v4 projector fails closed if such carryover reaches a step.

claim_scope.interpretation: V4 isolates a one-step hard feasibility projection around the selected v3 joint PPO configurations. Cells e-h remain descriptive only because they were already exposed by v2/v3.

safety.envelope_provenance: Rounded upward from the maximum total service and batch arrival observed across development cells a-d only: service max 2.130388, batch max 0.831723. The same rounded constants are frozen before replay/training and never use realized future evaluation values.

required_interpretation.a_d: Full a-d establishes hard-safety gate passage for the frozen development cells, but it does not create fresh untouched confirmatory data.
required_interpretation.e_h: E-h remains descriptive only and must not be used as a headline or generalization claim.
required_interpretation.projector_role: The shield is materially co-producing feasible behavior: replay intervention is small, but trained-policy intervention remains substantial, especially in Global.
required_interpretation.replay: Replay uses 20 archived v3 models evaluated in two modes. The flush variant is an economic ablation only.

scope.untouched_month_or_cell_claim: No new untouched month/cells were introduced by this frozen package.

descriptive_e_h.interpretation: Descriptive non-confirmatory transfer only. Cells e-h were already exposed by frozen v2/v3 and are not headline-eligible.
